One who faces a Honorable One at the last

beats.title: A Knife in the Dark, Foiled

beats.statement: The court of the Mad King assembles, and the Herald opens the show.
The Mad King decrees that the Friday bottle and the throne go to the last contestant standing. The Herald proclaims it.
Aino poisons a goblet and serves it to Liisa. Liisa drinks it and dies. This is the first blood of the contest.
The Herald speaks a prophecy about who will win the throne, and Matti hears it.
Aino poisons a goblet meant for Kalle, but the cups get swapped and Aino drinks it. Aino dies; Kalle survives, unharmed.

announcements.headline: Aino is OUT
announcements.cause: poisoned by the goblet meant for Kalle

beats.statement: Pekka renounces the crown, takes the Grey Cloak and leaves the contest for the Wall.

announcements.headline: Pekka is OUT
announcements.cause: forfeited by taking the Grey Cloak

beats.statement: Someone tries to poison Matti. The Food Taster tastes the food first and dies in their place. Matti survives.
Kalle and Sanna swear an alliance to stand together.
The Iron Vault calls in Matti's debt. Matti cannot pay and is exiled from the realm.

announcements.headline: Matti is OUT
announcements.cause: exiled by the Iron Vault for an unpaid debt

beats.statement: The Mad King pardons Öhman for an offence against the crown, for now.
The Mad King sees Öhman as a threat to the throne and banishes them from the realm.
Sanna tries to stab their ally Kalle in the back, but fails. Kalle survives, and the alliance between them is broken.
The Red Priestess brings Liisa back from the dead. Liisa is alive again and back in the contest.

announcements.headline: Liisa RETURNS
announcements.cause: raised from the dead by the Red Priestess and back in the contest

beats.statement: The Iron Vault calls in Kalle's debt. Kalle cannot pay and is exiled from the realm.

announcements.headline: Kalle is OUT
announcements.cause: exiled by the Iron Vault for an unpaid debt

beats.statement: Jääskeläinen faces the dragon alone, trips onto their own sword and dies. The dragon survives.

announcements.headline: Jääskeläinen is OUT
announcements.cause: tripped onto their own sword during the dragon duel

beats.statement: Sanna narrowly escapes a deadly accident and stays in the contest.
The Herald wounds Sanna in a fight. Sanna survives, but is hurt.
Sanna and Liisa, the last two contestants, fight the final duel. Liisa is killed.

announcements.headline: Liisa is OUT
announcements.cause: defeated by Sanna in the Last Duel

beats.statement: Sanna is crowned the new monarch of the Bottle Throne by the Mad King.

thread_seeds.title: Someone wants Matti dead
thread_seeds.summary: The poison was meant for Matti; the danger has not passed.

thread_seeds.title: The alliance of Kalle and Sanna
thread_seeds.summary: Kalle and Sanna swear to stand together, and must face what that costs.

thread_seeds.title: Öhman is spared, for now
thread_seeds.summary: Öhman escapes once, and the story comes back for them.

thread_seeds.title: Sanna turns on Kalle
thread_seeds.summary: After the failed knife, Kalle knows Sanna cannot be trusted.

thread_seeds.title: Liisa cheats death
thread_seeds.summary: Liisa falls, is raised by the Red Priestess, and must live with the price.

thread_seeds.title: Sanna is spared, for now
thread_seeds.summary: Sanna escapes once, and the story comes back for them.

thread_seeds.title: Sanna's wound
thread_seeds.summary: the Herald wounded Sanna, and the wound is not forgotten.

thread_seeds.title: The prophecy
thread_seeds.summary: The seer's riddle is spoken early and fulfilled at the coronation.

thread_seeds.title: Sanna's road
thread_seeds.summary: Sanna keeps finding a way through.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Hear ye! The bottle awaits a worthy hand.

lines.speaker: old_king
lines.text: I am the Mad King, and this throne is still warm.

lines.speaker: npc_herald
lines.text: Let the peasants step forward!

lines.speaker: npc_herald
lines.text: Silence for the crown!

lines.speaker: old_king
lines.text: Only one of you shall wear it. Begin!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Somewhere, a goat bleats ominously.

lines.speaker: p04
lines.text: I saw nothing. I will remember everything.

lines.speaker: p04
lines.text: Strange vintage...

lines.speaker: p01
lines.text: Very rare. Very final.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Liisa falls, and is out of the contest.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The candles gutter. The seer's eyes roll back.

lines.speaker: npc_herald
lines.text: One who bears the sign of the Crab. One who bled and did not fall.

lines.speaker: p05
lines.text: Clearly it means me.

lines.speaker: p06
lines.text: Is it always like this around here?

lines.speaker: p01
lines.text: Cheers, everyone!

lines.speaker: p03
lines.text: Wasn't that the cup you poured for me?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Aino falls, and is out of the contest.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The ghost of Liisa has come to watch.

lines.speaker: p04
lines.text: Now we are even.

lines.speaker: p07
lines.text: I saw nothing. I will remember everything.

lines.speaker: p06
lines.text: I renounce the crown. The Wall needs me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Pekka walks north, wrapped in grey.

lines.speaker: npc_food_taster
lines.text: Just a sip, for safety.

lines.speaker: p05
lines.text: Is it... safe?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Someone was trying very hard to poison Matti.

captions.text: THE FOOD TASTER EARNS HIS WAGE

lines.speaker: p07
lines.text: My sword is yours, Kalle.

lines.speaker: p03
lines.text: And mine is... somewhere near yours.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Iron Vault sends its regards, and its bill.

lines.speaker: p05
lines.text: Can I pay in compliments?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Matti is escorted to the harbor. One way.

lines.speaker: old_king
lines.text: I am feeling generous. Rise, Öhman.

lines.speaker: p08
lines.text: Thank you? I think?

lines.speaker: old_king
lines.text: Öhman, you are banished. Today.

lines.speaker: p08
lines.text: You cannot do this!

lines.speaker: old_king
lines.text: Crown says I can.

lines.speaker: p07
lines.text: Goodnight, sweet ally.

lines.speaker: p03
lines.text: Not tonight, traitor!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The blade bounces off a lucky belt buckle.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Flames rise. The Red Priestess whispers old words.

lines.speaker: p04
lines.text: I... was dead? Did I miss lunch?

lines.speaker: p02
lines.text: Somebody should write this down.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Iron Vault sends its regards, and its bill.

lines.speaker: p03
lines.text: Can I pay in compliments?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kalle is escorted to the harbor. One way.

lines.speaker: p02
lines.text: First, a magnificent entrance.

lines.speaker: p02
lines.text: No, sword! The OTHER direction!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Jääskeläinen falls, and is out of the contest.

captions.text: Jääskeläinen trips onto their own sword and dies. The dragon survives.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A falling gargoyle misses Sanna by a hair.

lines.speaker: p07
lines.text: I meant to do that!

lines.speaker: p07
lines.text: It is only a flesh wound.

lines.speaker: npc_herald
lines.text: It is quite a lot of flesh.

lines.speaker: p04
lines.text: Only one of us leaves this place, Sanna.

lines.speaker: p07
lines.text: Then I will hold the door for you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Steel rings. The rival's rod snaps. It is over.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Liisa falls, and is out of the contest.

lines.speaker: p07
lines.text: As the prophecy foretold!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The realm cheers. The bottle gleams.

chronicle.epilogue: When the dust settled, Sanna the Fool sat upon the Bottle Throne. 8 rivals fell, fled or were sent away along the way. The old crown passed on, the prophecy came true, and the bottle was finally opened. Long may Sanna reign, at least until next Friday.
chronicle.cover_title: The Bottle Throne: A Clash of Corks
chronicle.blurb: 8 peasants. One bottle. Alliances, betrayals and a very suspicious goat. Who will be crowned when the curtain falls?
